results.title: Romancing the Stone
results.overview: Though she can spin wild tales of passionate romance, novelist Joan Wilder has no life of her own. Then one day adventure comes her way in the form of a mysterious package. It turns out that the parcel is the ransom she'll need to free her abducted sister, so Joan flies to South America to hand it over. But she gets on the wrong bus and winds up hopelessly stranded in the jungle.

results.name: Romancing the Stone: The Golden Ages of British Sculpture
results.original_name: Romancing the Stone: The Golden Ages of British Sculpture
results.overview: Alastair Sooke examines three periods in the history of British sculpture and the masterpieces they produced.

results.title: The Jewel of the Nile
results.overview: Joan Wilder is thrust back into a world of murder, chases, foreign intrigue... and love. This time out she's duped by a duplicitous Arab dignitary who brings her to the Middle East, ostensibly to write a book about his life. Of course, he's up to no good, and Joan is just another pawn in his wicked game. But Jack Colton and his sidekick Ralph show up to help our intrepid heroine save the day.
